title: The Bear and the Pear
lines: A brown bear sat by a pear tree.
He had not had a meal all day.
The best pears were up in the air.
The bear stood up tall on his back paws.
He could not reach. Not even close.
So he got a chair from his den.
But the chair had a big tear in it.
He stood on it. The chair fell down.
The bear fell too, and sat on the grass.
He had a sad face for a while.
Then he had a plan. He hugged the tree.
He shook it hard with both paws.
Ten pears came down all at once.
The bear ate three and saved the rest.

questions.ask: Why did the bear get a chair?
questions.listenFor: To get up to the pears, which were up in the air. The answer is in the third and sixth lines.

questions.ask: How did the bear get the pears down in the end?
questions.listenFor: He hugged the tree and shook it hard. Point out that pear, bear and tear all rhyme.

questions.ask: Do you think the bear will try the chair again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason, not the right answer.
